name: Rhubarb
definition: fresh or frozen rhubarb stalks (leaf stems), sold forced or field-grown, cooked with sugar.
notes: PLU Finder 4745 Rhubarb, alt names Garden Rhubarb, Rhubarb Stalks, Tart Stems; vegetable stalks

name: Okra [lady's finger, bhindi]
definition: fresh or frozen okra, the immature green seed capsule eaten whole.
notes: PLU Finder 4655 Okra Regular (Green); separate 4657 Red Okra; sold whole as pods

name: Pumpkin and winter squash [winter squash]
definition: fresh or frozen pumpkin or winter squash, hard-rinded and eaten mature (butternut, kabocha, acorn, spaghetti); soft-skinned summer squash is courgette.
notes: PLU pumpkin page lists pumpkin only, no butternut or other winter squash; 10 rows

name: Mandarin [tangerine]
definition: fresh mandarin or tangerine other than clementine and satsuma, including mandarin hybrids sold as mandarins (Murcott, Nadorcott).
notes: PLU lists 34 mandarin codes; clementine and satsuma separate rows; Honey/Murcott listed, Nadorcott not

name: Apricot
notes: PLU Finder 3422 Apricot, commodity apricots, all sizes; stone fruit

name: Lime
definition: fresh lime, Persian (Tahiti) or Key (Mexican) types.
notes: PLU Finder 4048 Lime, regular incl. Persian, Tahiti, Bearss; no Key lime row seen

name: Cauliflower
definition: fresh or frozen cauliflower, whole head or florets, of any curd colour.
notes: PLU Finder 4571 Cauliflower, retailer assigned, all sizes; own commodity

name: Leek
notes: PLU Finder 4629 Leek, regular, all sizes; own commodity leeks

name: Radish
definition: fresh radish of any type, small red or long white (daikon).
notes: PLU Finder 4598 Radish (daikon); 4742 red and 4740 bunched white also radish

name: Green bean [French bean, string bean]
definition: fresh or frozen immature bean pods eaten whole (French, runner, yardlong beans); dried beans are J5.
notes: PLU Finder 4066 Green Beans, Green/French; 3048 flat Romano also listed

name: Oyster mushroom
definition: fresh oyster mushroom (Pleurotus), including king oyster.
notes: PLU mushrooms page: Oyster row PLU 4649, all sizes

name: Enoki
definition: fresh enoki mushroom (Flammulina), sold in clusters.
notes: PLU mushrooms page: Enoki row PLU 3103, all sizes

name: Morel
definition: fresh morel; dried morels are J5.
notes: PLU mushrooms page: Morel row PLU 3102, all sizes

name: Cep [porcini]
definition: fresh cep or porcini (Boletus edulis group); dried is J5.
notes: PLU mushrooms page: Cep row PLU 3404; porcini synonym not shown on page
